_comment: Browser library that EMITS. None of the three shared variants fits as-is: base.json is Node-typed and DOM-less, while react.json has the right lib but is noEmit + jsx + allowImportingTsExtensions (and turning noEmit off there trips TS5096). So: extend base.json for the emitting/nodenext half, and override lib/types for the browser half. `types: []` is load-bearing - it keeps Node globals from type-checking in code that only ever runs in a browser.
